column1: # corpus-census-java.tsv — the PINNED java census roster.  SOUNDNESS R663.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS.  There was no standing java corpus.  `bin/corpus.sh` acquires FIVE jars, and
# the register cites java measurements over 325, 371, 372 and 395 jars — runs whose rosters were
# assembled ad hoc by individual agents and deleted with their scratchpads.  So every java figure in
# the register rests on a corpus nobody can reconstruct, and R662's census (which priced what a month
# of soundness work changes for a user) COULD NOT BE REPEATED for the reference engine at all.
# It was not a disk constraint: 58 GB were free when this was found.  Nothing owned the roster.
# THIS IS NOT THE ORACLE ROSTER.  corpus.sh's five jars are chosen for the SHAPES they expose — read
# its comments, sqlite-jdbc is there because it is the only jar that reaches one serialization filter,
# and dropping it "for being another database driver" would silently retire that check.  This file is
# chosen for SCALE, so that a percentage has a denominator.  Both are needed and neither substitutes.
# EVERY LINE WAS VERIFIED BY ACQUISITION, NOT BY RECALL.  118 of 121 candidates resolved against
# Maven Central on 2026-09-25; the sha1 in column 2 is Central's OWN `.jar.sha1` sidecar, fetched at
# the same time.  Three candidates were dropped or corrected because they 404'd — `mysql-connector-java`
# groupId, which is exactly the rot a hand-written, unverified list accumulates silently.
# A JAR THAT RESOLVES IS NOT A JAR THAT CONTAINS CLASSES — found on this roster's FIRST use, 2026-09-25.
# `com.squareup.okio:okio:3.9.0` verified, downloaded and sha1-matched perfectly, and holds ZERO `.class`
# files: it is the Kotlin **Multiplatform metadata** artifact, and every engine build correctly refuses it
# at exit 2.  The JVM artifact is `okio-jvm`.  So sha1 verification proves INTEGRITY, not FITNESS, and a
# Maven coordinate can be real, current, popular and still contribute nothing to a denominator.
# Corrected here; the same shape to watch for is any `-metadata`, BOM or `-sources` coordinate.
# groupId:artifactId:version<TAB>sha1.  Acquire with: bash bin/corpus-census.sh java
